note: Gate-checkable projection of the QA Checklist in ../../SKILL.md (authoritative). All gates are type=manual: OV-CRAFT quality turns on expert sign-off, safety-callout placement, technical executability, and design/render inspection rather than computable formulas. Project count is taken verbatim from the title and is never computed; page bands and section counts are advisory ranges, so no python ops module exists.

GATE_1_pre_creation_foundation.text: Trademark Clearance Report completed; verdict CLEAR or operator-approved CAUTION; all candidate subtitles passed the trademark screen
Sub-niche code assigned (CRAFT-FIBER/WOOD/GLASS/RESIN/PAPER/CANDLE-SOAP/CERAMIC/GENERAL/GARDEN/JEWELRY); secondary codes listed if multi-craft
Project count extracted from the title and recorded (or flagged unspecified); framework never invents or overrides it
Audience and difficulty range identified (skill level, age audience, complexity signal)
Auto-configuration announced (pathway, page band, visual density, font size, line spacing, Design Signature)
Expert panel confirmed with the correct specialists for the sub-niche; safety standard set identified (OSHA/CPSC/ANSI as applicable)
Cultural-sensitivity pre-check: techniques requiring attribution identified before writing
Operator confirmed the Design Signature is not a repeat (differs from last five; >=3 of 6 dimensions; no shared primary accent)

GATE_2_content_development_per_project.text: Every Project Unit has all required elements: Title, META line, Hero image/prompt, Materials with quantities, numbered one-action steps, Expected result, Project Facts Table
Safety Callout Box present at every hazard step, not only in the Introduction
Step images (or STEP IMAGE PROMPT blocks) present for every step
No registered brand names in instructional text
Measurements appear in both metric and imperial with correct marketplace primary
Pattern abbreviations used are defined in the front-matter glossary
Anti-AI language protocol enforced; step verb family consistent with the Voice Persona

Project written step by step and EVERY Step N carries its own embedded image (photoreal/diagram, matches the step's action, realism law checked); fiber Round/Row patterns image every technique change and at minimum one per 5 rounds/rows; a step without its image FAILS this project

GATE_3_section_review.text: Section Divider page completed with section overview and project preview thumbnails
All projects in the section technically executable as written; Master Multi-Craft Coordinator sign-off; no undocumented techniques
Textile Arts Specialist reviewed stitch notations; Construction & Home Systems Authority reviewed power-tool and chemical steps
Project Facts Table accurate (gauge/tool sizes/cure times verified); time realistic for difficulty; cost reflects current market ranges
Hero/step images photorealistic (no vectors/cartoons); visual continuity maintained (same hands, tools, lighting, setting)
Section word count and page estimate within the page-band target

GATE_4_final_certification.text: All N projects from the title present as complete Project Units; total count matches the title exactly
Front matter complete and ordered: Title -> Copyright -> TOC -> Preface -> How to Use -> Introduction; Preface 1 page; How to Use 1 page; Conclusion 1.5 pages
Appendix contains all seven elements (difficulty index, materials master list, glossary, conversion chart, supplier directory, planner template, troubleshooting)
Visible page numbers start at Introduction; front matter unnumbered; Design Signature and two-color interior applied consistently
Author name (First, M. Surname) consistent across Title Page, Copyright Page, and metadata
100% safety accuracy: all tool/chemical/electrical callouts validated against CPSC/OSHA/ANSI for the sub-niche
Cultural attributions validated by the Textile Arts & Cultural Preservation Specialist; KDP category assignments confirmed; no prohibited AI-pattern language

HOUSE TOC ARCHITECTURE followed (operator directive 2026-08-19): Introduction (standard H2 set) -> CHAPTER 1 toolkit/materials -> CHAPTER 2 core techniques -> project chapters in one sanctioned grouping mode (difficulty ladder / category tiers with continuous project numbering / technique curriculum + flat PROJECT N headings) -> TROUBLESHOOTING chapter -> lettered Appendices (3-4 from the sub-niche menu) -> Acknowledgments

Every chapter/part/project heading carries a real Word Heading style (H1 chapters/parts/flat projects, H2 in-chapter projects and subsections); the TOC is a LIVE Word field built from those styles, no hand-typed entries; direct-formatted bold text posing as a heading is a FAIL
Chapter titles use 'CHAPTER N: DESCRIPTIVE NAME' in block caps (28pt+ at 8.5x11); tier chapters may carry '(PROJECTS X-Y)' ranges; PART openers used when 4+ product categories

Project units use the exact house labels in house order (fiber: Skill Level/Yarn/Hook/Gauge/Finished Size/Abbreviations/Pattern Notes/Round-Row N/Assembly/Finishing; non-fiber: Difficulty/Time/Materials/Tools/Step N/Assembly/Finishing/Tip/Variation); improvised labels (What You Need, Supplies, Directions) are a FAIL
Book closes Troubleshooting chapter -> Appendices A/B/C(+) -> Acknowledgments; safety checklist appendix present for baby/child-use projects; no generic Conclusion chapter
Chapter-level headings (H1) are BLOCK LETTERS; subchapter headings (H2) are Sentence case; convention consistent through the whole book
Every H1 unit (chapter, part opener, appendix, Acknowledgments, flat PROJECT N) starts on a new page via page-break-before, never empty-paragraph stacks
Page numbers start at the Introduction as page 1; front matter shows no folios; final TOC reworked against the final rendered layout and verified entry by entry
